finalText:
**Wrote the 4.2.0 section into [CHANGELOG.md:3](CHANGELOG.md:3).** Out of 380 commits, 14 matter to users.

Three break things. Error types stopped being re-exported from `auth`, `billing`, `core`, `db`, `jobs`. The v1 export route is gone. An expired token now returns 401, not 403. One feature: webhook retries with backoff. Ten real fixes, including the request body no longer landing in logs.

Two calls I made for you. Nine `perf` commits are left out, since your template allows only Breaking, Added, Fixed. `docs: note the minimum node version` touched only docs, so I did not treat it as a support drop.

Next: check whether the node floor actually moved.
